crossRefs.note: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:
“Stand in the gate of Yahweh’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, all you of Judah, who…
Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.
Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says…
“Yet hear Yahweh’s word, O Zedekiah king of Judah: Yahweh says concerning you, ‘You won’t die by the sword.
Moreover Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, “Hear Yahweh’s word, all Judah who are in the land…

Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to…
“At that time,” says Yahweh, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”

people.name: Israel
